notes: One-woman driving school run by Karin van de Sande (sole/vaste instructeur, vaste lesauto), category B only. Gecertificeerd RIS-instructeur, lessons via Rijopleiding in Stappen method; offers faalangstexamen (€350) so suitable for anxious learners. Founding conflict: own 'even voorstellen' page says she started as a rijinstructeur in 2017 then went independent; KvK 73870897 plus '7 jaar ervaring' (clickdrive/rijschool-tips) and rijloket 'Sinds 2019 actief als rijschool' point to ~2019 as the business founding year (used here). ENTITY DISAMBIGUATION: distinct from 'Autorijschool van de Sanden' (Frans, rijschoolvds.nl, Berkel-Enschot, tel 06 48487091) and 'Autorijschool van der Sande' (Maastricht, autorijschoolvdsande.nl) — rijloket.nl mixed our Vlijmen school's stats with Frans's rijschoolvds.nl website/phone. clickdrive lists an alternate phone +31 6 28818132; the school's own site number is 06 23 88 02 84. CBR exam counts on aggregators (34 / 30-41 in Den Bosch) are consistent with the given 39.
